paraphrase: Whoever bears an occurring thought episode opines that episode's content: ∀ b e, Occurs e → Bears b e → Opines b (content e). An open bridge from the Cogito bearer vocabulary to the opining vocabulary of STMT-OPINION-IS-A-MOTION. It restricts the selected episodes to judgings or appearings with a propositional content; a willing or a non-propositional episode would falsify it.
